Name: cantibleChaos's BFAV Peafowl for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from cantibleChaos, I have converted their BFAV Peafowl (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9067) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to cantibleChaos for the original mod. 

Peafowl live in coops and produce peafowl eggs that can be made into mayo, and a colorful variety of feathers.

Enjoy!
